name: Super SMS Dataset: author temporal subset 2018–2023
encoding: ISO-8859-1 (lossless byte decoding; preserves publisher text without replacing invalid UTF-8 bytes)
temporal_provenance: Author Data/README.md at this snapshot identifies DS_latest.csv as 2018–2023. Publication describes 2,325 ham collected from consenting volunteers October 2021–June 2023 in the combined corpus. Individual receipt dates, volunteer membership and sender IDs are unavailable; do not assign those dates to every row.
rights: Authors publicly offer the corpus for research and request citation. Repository has no explicit standard data license. Raw messages are acquired locally, excluded from Git, and not redistributed here; check upstream terms for other uses.
limitations: Mixed component corpora; some component dates may describe dataset release rather than receipt.
Manual author labels use broad spam rules and may differ from recipient consent.
Not evidence about representative 2025–2026 SMS or Russian/Kazakh messages.
Source-independent of previous project corpora after text screening, but new train/validation/test share this author corpus; new test is a held-out group sample, not an entirely unseen provider.
